# CommandPrompt Inc.

> > Enterprise PostgreSQL support, consulting, and education from the experts at CommandPrompt Inc.

CommandPrompt Inc. provides 24/7 PostgreSQL enterprise support, database consulting, and comprehensive tutorials for database administrators and developers. The company specializes in Postgres optimization, migration, and full-stack database services.

## Key Topics

- PostgreSQL
- Postgres database administration
- Enterprise database support
- PostgreSQL functions and utilities
- JSON/JSONB operations
- Array functions
- Server management (start/stop/restart)
- pg_ctl utility
- pgAdmin
- SSH connections
- Active connections monitoring
- Date and time functions
- Windows PostgreSQL
- Database best practices
- SLA support services

## Enterprise Support & Services

- [Support — CommandPrompt Inc.](https://commandprompt.com/support): 24/7 PostgreSQL enterprise support with SLA, EOL support, and full-stack services
- [Contact Us — CommandPrompt Inc.](https://commandprompt.com/contact-us): Contact form and office location for CommandPrompt Inc. in Bellingham, WA

## PostgreSQL Tutorials & Education

- [PostgreSQL & Open Source Tutorials | Database Best Practices](https://commandprompt.com/education): PostgreSQL tutorials and open source support hub by CommandPrompt Inc.
- [How to Start, Stop, or Restart the PostgreSQL Server? — CommandPrompt Inc.](https://commandprompt.com/education/how-to-start-stop-or-restart-the-postgresql-server): Guide to managing PostgreSQL server on Windows using pg_ctl and net commands
- [How to List Sessions/Active Connections in PostgreSQL — CommandPrompt Inc.](https://commandprompt.com/education/how-to-list-sessionsactive-connections-in-postgresql): Tutorial on monitoring active PostgreSQL connections using pg_stat_activity
- [How to Get Current Date and Time in PostgreSQL — CommandPrompt Inc.](https://commandprompt.com/education/how-to-get-current-date-and-time-in-postgresql): Tutorial on PostgreSQL date/time functions: NOW(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, LOCALTIMESTAMP

## PostgreSQL Functions Reference

- [How to Use jsonb_build_object() Function in PostgreSQL — CommandPrompt Inc.](https://commandprompt.com/education/how-to-use-jsonb_build_object-function-in-postgresql): PostgreSQL tutorial on jsonb_build_object() for JSON key-value manipulation
- [How to Use ARRAY_UPPER() Function in PostgreSQL — CommandPrompt Inc.](https://commandprompt.com/education/how-to-use-array_upper-function-in-postgresql): Guide to PostgreSQL ARRAY_UPPER() function for array dimension operations
